tldr: Morning batch, Aug 16: Anthropic's IPO will be priced off a $190-200B 2028 revenue forecast while Nvidia halves its OpenAI Ohio backstop to under $120B after investor pushback; the US tells 35 countries to pick a side in the AI race. DeepSeek V4's peak/off-peak API pricing goes live today at 16:00 UTC — cache-hit input up to 12x at peak, the sharpest squeeze hits agentic workloads. Hermes Agent's Bot Mode — persistent per-profile agent chats that talk to each other — ships in Desktop Monday Aug 17 after a one-day beta, and Dario Amodei re-frames Anthropic's regulatory stance around pre-deployment testing plus FINRA-like oversight that advantages open weights. Qwen3.8-27B spreads to LM Studio, MediaTek on-device and RTX Spark, then one-shots a Super Mario clone from a local Q8 GGUF; Kimi K3 text support lands in llama.cpp; Nous Portal pushes a guaranteed 20%-discount aggregator play.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Priced Off $190-200B 2028 Revenue Forecast
articles.summary: Bankers are valuing the listing on 2028 revenue, not today's: $190-200B against a $47B run rate. Q2 revenue $10.9B, first operating profit $559M.

articles.title: Nvidia Halves OpenAI Ohio Data-Center Backstop to Under $120B
articles.summary: Investors balked at the risk: the $250B guarantee shrinks to <$120B, and a first-phase deal could sign this weekend.

articles.title: US Tells 35 Countries to Pick a Side in the AI Race
articles.summary: Draft State Dept letter warns Pax Silica members they'll be excluded if they also join Beijing's WAICO. Kazakhstan, in both camps, is the test case.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Peak/Off-Peak API Pricing Goes Live Today
articles.summary: 16:00 UTC today: cache-hit input rises up to 12x at peak — the sharpest squeeze hits agentic workloads. V4-Pro output $0.87 → $1.98 off-peak / $3.96 peak.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Bot Mode Ships Monday in Desktop
articles.summary: Persistent per-profile agent 'bots' that talk to each other graduate from their one-day public beta into the main Hermes Desktop app Aug 17.

articles.title: Dario Amodei Re-Frames Anthropic's Regulatory Stance
articles.summary: 'Concentrate or distribute' is a false choice: policy should constrain frontier labs while advantaging open weights — pre-deployment testing plus a FINRA-like entity.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B Live on LM Studio, MediaTek and RTX Spark
articles.summary: Within 24h of release: LM Studio local inference, MediaTek smartphones/vehicles on-device, NVIDIA RTX Spark — the fastest local-distribution play of any open model this year.

articles.title: Nous Portal Positions as Discount Aggregator
articles.summary: Hundreds of models, bundled external tool usage, guaranteed minimum 20% discount across providers — a pricing play on the model-gateway layer.

articles.title: Kimi K3 Text Model Support Lands in llama.cpp
articles.summary: PR #26185 by pwilkin adds the Kimi-K3 text model to llama.cpp — local inference support for Moonshot's flagship arrives on the community stack.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B One-Shots a Super Mario Clone From a Local Q8 GGUF
articles.summary: Running Q8 on a Framework Desktop: not fast, but smart enough to one-shot a Super Mario clone — a striking community datapoint for a 27B local model.

articles.title: AI Isn't Outthinking Mathematicians — It's Out-Remembering Them
articles.summary: Top HN essay (302 pts, 260 comments): frontier models ace known problems by memorizing patterns at scale, not by genuinely new mathematical insight.
